scope: Close the remaining FT5 depletion/recovery gate without changing accepted FT5.3a dynamics: implement the declared demand partial order including target identity, run the fixed matched reserve grid across both content settings, all three reserve policies, initial reserve {0,4,8}, load {1,2,4}, token inventory {0,2}, both native wallet models and fixed ample/scarce budgets, independently reconstruct every cell, and apply the already declared load-v1 release election only if every invariant holds.

source_contract.continuation_plan: Full Theory Engine Batched Plan revision 1.1, FT5.3
source_contract.release_rule: Choose load-v1 as the minimal non-null candidate if all registered invariants and the complete grid hold; otherwise hold the release. Do not tune the rule or any grid coordinate after observing outcomes.

grid.construction: Each cell begins from a fresh matched supplied fixture. Wallet model and finite initial native budget are fixed at engine construction. The grid performs one actual reserve-conditioned native candidate step; it does not fabricate route, grade, support, success, reserve delta or replenishment evidence.
grid.token_interpretation: The zero/two inventory axis is observed at admission. With no paid replenishment event in a grid admission cell, token inventory must cause no balance or route difference. FT5.3a remains the accepted actual paid token-uptake/restart witness.

correction.preserved_attempt: Attempt 1 stopped before acceptance: canonical grade-v1 at initial native budget 87 exhausted during the supplied owned-need setup and therefore could not form a valid grid fixture; legacy-r4 at 87 remained constructible.
correction.change: Canonical scarce initial native budget is 90 for both wallet models. This is the lowest shared tested fixture budget that constructs both models; it leaves a bounded scarce wallet and changes no reserve policy, axis, demand, work limit, release rule or expected outcome.
correction.status: Prospectively frozen before the corrected implementation/evaluation run; a second gate failure after this correction holds FT5.3b.

demand_order.harder: Same family, context, cue and target; superset requirements and obligations; subset alternatives and support allowed; load no lower; deadline no later; at least one strict coordinate.
demand_order.equivalent: Each demand is no easier than the other under the exact partial order.
demand_order.incomparable: Neither demand is no easier than the other. A changed target or crossed stronger/weaker constraints must be reported as incomparable, never reduced to a scalar.

invariants: Every grid identity is the exact Cartesian product; no cell is omitted, duplicated or replaced after results are known.
The engine's committed resource model and finite wallet establish each model/budget coordinate; coordinate labels alone are insufficient.
Admission preparation is zero for null and max(0, load-reserve) for non-null policies. Admission never changes reserve balance.
All six native route alternatives and their reasons remain visible. Zero reserve adds a separately payable preparation obligation and does not prohibit a route.
Token inventory is finite and exact. In the absence of a distinct paid uptake, it causes no replenishment, balance change or route selection effect.
Native wallet debits, route work and reserve accounting remain separate and independently auditable. TIM, dimensionality, resource defaults, baseline and accepted failures do not change.

The release decision is load-v1 exactly when the full grid, partial-order laws, FT5.3a paid recovery predecessor and all registered invariants pass. Null and grade-load-v1 remain reported alternatives.
Engineering acceptance does not settle C13/TD4 theoretical realism and is not psychological validation.
gate: Thirteen exact FT5.3b methods pass with zero failures/errors; all 432 frozen grid cells and their actual model/budget coordinates reconstruct independently; the real demand partial order includes target scope and reports crossed constraints as incomparable; all FT5.3a-and-earlier method identities remain exact; source is unchanged after freeze; and the prospective release rule selects load-v1 or explicitly holds release without tuning.

theory_boundary: Passing closes the bounded FT5 engineering gate and elects only a release configuration. C13, TD4 realism, D-series claims and psychological validity remain open.
